# Surviving Results and Open Obligations

Statuses below are scoped to exact claims. `accepted-inherited` means a recorded internal verdict was traced, not that this mapping independently proved it.

## Models and Policies

- **global:** Uniform Omega(N,m;id) over all ordered labeled all-transposition words, arbitrary support.
- **endpoint:** Uniform Omega(N,m;sigma) with specified feasible permutation endpoint; all transpositions.
- **star:** Uniform prescribed-endpoint words using only (i,N); different generator set used as a primitive.
- **connected:** Uniform identity words with connected support on the entire specified label set.
- **connected-endpoint:** Uniform connected words with specified endpoint; length v+cycles(sigma)-2+2g.
- **heatbath:** Fixed Omega(N,m), m>=4: K=I/2 + (1/[2|R_m|]) sum_{r in R_m} (1/[m-r+1]) sum_i H_{i,r}, R_m={3,4,5} intersect [1,m]; H uniformly refreshes same-product consecutive blocks. No circular windows.
- **auxiliary:** An explicitly named quotient, restricted, comparison or ideal chain; not interchangeable with the full K.
- **other-generators:** Different generator libraries, including expander benchmarks; implementation and endpoint-conditioned sampling must be specified anew.
- **crypto-gibbs:** Speculative computational hardness/pseudorandomness or different expected-length stationary targets.
- **experiment:** Finite diagnostic or separate graph-process experiment; no asymptotic sampler theorem implied.
- **relaxed-endpoint:** Uniform length-m all-transposition words with N-cycles(eval(w))<=k, identity center; a different target from exact bridges. Kernel and correction budget must be declared.

All direct samplers below use independent fair bits in their mathematical model; seeded finite PRNG tests are reproducibility checks, not a proof of exact randomness.

Let P=N+m+2 and K=max{1<=v<=N: v^(2v)<=P^4}, fixed at the original top-level input. H0 permits every component with g<=1 OR v<=K. H1 permits only v<=K. Isolates have size 1, length 0; both policies permit arbitrary genus on small supports.

H2 permits every component of size at most L=max{1<=v<=N:3^v<=P^4}. Each policy has an exact uniform law on its own allowed subset, not automatically on all Omega. Global TV is exactly the omitted count fraction, 1-Z_allowed/Z.

These cutoffs are fixed by the original (N,m), never silently recomputed after deleting components. Polynomial state counts can coexist with an allowed subset of vanishing global mass.

For arbitrary all-transposition endpoints (N>=2), feasibility is m>=N-cycles(sigma) with matching parity. The star-generator model has its own feasibility criterion, not this one.

Positive defect-type DP samples every feasible endpoint exactly in exp(O(sqrt(min(m,N)))) poly(N,m) expected bit time; in particular polynomial for m<=A(log N)^2 with fixed A.

<a id="s-dense"></a>
## S-DENSE: Sharper dense length/error theorem

Let q=floor(m/[2N(N-1)]). If q>=4ceil(log2 N), TV<=min(1,3N^2 exp(-q/144)). It suffices for error epsilon that m>=2N(N-1)ceil(144 ln(3N^2/epsilon)).

- Effective status: **accepted-inherited**; source: proved / accepted in the linked internal run
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. Documentary trace of the stated scope and cited verdict; no proof rederivation, experiment rerun, or formal verification by this mapping.
- Model: endpoint; parameters: N,m and epsilon; expected polynomial bit time; conservative O(N^4 m^3) exact arithmetic operations.
- Guards: N>=5 and feasible endpoint; degrees 2..4 exact. Error guarantee depends on length, not more runtime at fixed (N,m).
- Assumptions: Stable-sort word bijection; Feray star counts; CLR Theorem 1.1 with discrete-time parity normalization; exact retained floors and endpoint-conditioned count bound.
- Remaining obligation: None for the recorded restricted statement; generalizations are separate records.
- Limitations: At m=O(N^2 log N) with a fixed constant the displayed error is only inverse-polynomial; negligible error needs q/log N -> infinity or a specified stronger schedule. Implementation evidence is partial primitive/branch validation, not a fresh production end-to-end audit.
- Version / verdict binding: R2 Theorem D, equations D3-D19 and epsilon corollary; R1 fresh_dense_audit accepts the final/frozen report on 2026-09-05. Current bytes pinned; no historical report digest in the verdict.

<a id="s-quotient"></a>
## S-QUOTIENT: Larger exact small-support decoder

Simultaneous relabeling of prefix permutation and exposed support partition gives at most 3^(v-1) states. Literal next-edge weighting remains exact. Thus all-genus components up to L=max{1<=v<=N:3^v<=P^4} can be decoded under a polynomial cap.

- Effective status: **accepted-inherited**; source: proved / accepted in the linked internal run
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. Documentary trace of the stated scope and cited verdict; no proof rederivation, experiment rerun, or formal verification by this mapping.
- Model: connected; parameters: v,ell; fixed global P=N+m+2 and L; conservative O(P^24) expected bit time, O(P^12) storage.
- Guards: State retains the cycle partition within EACH exposed support block, not endpoint cycle type alone. The logarithmic support cutoff is capped at N.
- Assumptions: Support blocks are unions of prefix cycles; simultaneous relabeling is a Markov lumping with indexed-cycle multiplicities. Backward completion counts weight actual labeled next edges, and ternary separators bound the quotient inventory.
- Remaining obligation: None for the recorded restricted statement; generalizations are separate records.
- Limitations: Exact conditional primitive, not a full global accuracy theorem. Enlarging the cutoff alone still fails at the N^(3/4) benchmark.
- Version / verdict binding: The linked verdict names the cited statement/version; all linked files are pinned at integration. Where no historical hash was recorded, this is a documentary scope match, not proof of historical byte identity. See exact reviewer/date in the verdict.

<a id="hb-irred"></a>
## HB-IRRED: Local heat-bath qualitative foundations

The exact lazy random-scan {3,4,5} chain is stationary/reversible for global uniform words and irreducible for N>=3, even m>=4. The paired chain J satisfies gap(K)>=gap(J)/(3 binom(N,2)^2).

- Effective status: **accepted-inherited**; source: proved / accepted in the linked internal run
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. Documentary trace of the stated scope and cited verdict; no proof rederivation, experiment rerun, or formal verification by this mapping.
- Model: heatbath; parameters: N,m; kernel and laziness exactly as GOAL_SPEC; m=4 has gap(K)>=1/4 by whole-word refresh.
- Guards: m=0 and N=2 singleton exceptions; m=2 has no allowed window and must NOT inherit irreducibility.
- Assumptions: Ben-Itzhak-Teicher arXiv:math/0110110v1 Theorem 3.4 with inverse Hurwitz-generator translation; padded moves and square refresh.
- Remaining obligation: None for the recorded restricted statement; generalizations are separate records.

<a id="aux-tree-slides"></a>
## AUX-TREE-SLIDES: Polynomial mixing of labeled-tree edge slides

On all vertex-labeled N-trees, the half-lazy uniform-incident-pair/direction slide walk has stationary mass proportional to W(T)=sum_v binom(deg(v),2) and gap at least 2/[(N-1)^2(N-2)^2]. The same bound holds for its Metropolis uniform-tree correction and the uniform-target all-edge-pair rejection variant. All mix in O(N^4 [N log N + log(1/epsilon)]) steps.

- Effective status: **provisional**; source: proved graph theorem using a checked literature dependency; refuted ordinary-support Markov projection; circuit lift unresolved
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. Same-author proof plus exact checks through N=6: 1296 trees and 34920 nontrivial down-up exchanges at N=6; independent edge-subset state enumeration; all three stationary laws, routes, fixed-forest reconstruction and rational congestion loads. Theorems 1.1 and 5.2 and the source kernel definition checked. No independent referee or spectral extrapolation.
- Model: auxiliary; parameters: N>=3, distinguishable vertices, simple trees, no edge order, embedding, degree restriction or permutation endpoint. With probability 1/2 hold; otherwise choose the specified pair and one of its two edge slides uniformly. M accepts with min(1,W(T)/W(Tprime)); U holds on disjoint pairs.
- Guards: N=1,2 singletons. This is a graph model with functionality discarded, not an identity-word chain or a projection theorem for adjacent Hurwitz moves. Uniform incident-pair proposals are not uniform-tree stationary for N>=4. Time is polynomial in explicit N, not log N wires.
- Assumptions: Anari--Liu--Oveis Gharan--Vinzant arXiv:1811.01816v3 Theorems 1.1 and 5.2, specialized to the graphic matroid of K_N, give gap >=1/(N-1) for the precisely matched down-up reference chain. Cayley/Pruefer count supplies the TV state-size factor. Remaining comparison is proved in the source.
- Remaining obligation: Independent review of the new comparison. Any circuit application still requires a correct target-preserving lift, legal adjacent-word simulations with polynomial stationary-flow congestion, and control of order information.
- Limitations: Coarse polynomial exponent; complete labeled-tree state space only. No claim for uniformly distributed unlabeled shapes, degree restrictions, fixed endpoints or ordered circuit mixing.
- Version / verdict binding: 2026-10-14 report and ledger, exact artifacts pinned. Keep as an author-complete auxiliary proof, provisional pending independent review.

<a id="hb-decorrelation-bootstrap"></a>
## HB-DECORRELATION-BOOTSTRAP: Conditional tail decorrelation bootstraps local mixing across lengths

A universal bound rho(first third,last third)<=1-delta under every prescribed-endpoint uniform bridge gives Lambda_N(m)>=(delta/2)Lambda_N(m-floor(m/3)) for the actual adjacent Hurwitz/square walk. A polynomial short-length base gap therefore extends to all endpoints and lengths. The known length-three base suffices under this unproved static hypothesis. A scale-product weakening and an N/2-cutoff corollary are conditional. The stronger numerical guess rho<=1/2 is exactly refuted.

- Effective status: **provisional**; source: proved conditional bootstrap and exact rho<=1/2 refutation; finite rational certificates; empirical spectral estimates; uniform hypothesis and general mixing unresolved
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. 97 endpoint/length cases: S3,S4,S5 m4..12 and S6 m4..8. 37 exact rational rho<99/100 certificates at N<=4; required identity joint-count enumeration; exact S5,m4 correlation witness 917/1800; 499497 slot checks. Two power seeds, four iteration caps, no numerical upper-bound claim.
- Model: endpoint; parameters: N>=3; feasible m,g; uniform Omega_g(N,m), rightmost-first. K_A=I/2+H/4+R/4, uniform linear adjacent slots. Lambda_N(m)=(m-1) min_g gap(K_A). Tail lengths a=floor(m/3), middle m-2a. With delta universal, gap>=delta/[24(m-1)(m-2)^alpha], alpha=log(2/delta)/log(3/2), m>=4.
- Guards: The decorrelation premise is conjectured, not proved by finite checks. It controls all observables of separated tails under the endpoint-conditioned target, not only short marginals of an initializer. An inverse-polynomial loss at every recursive level may compound into quasipolynomial time. Normalize random scan only once.
- Assumptions: Uniform tail-correlation deficit for the main conditional theorem; prior all-endpoint length-three K_A gap. The N/2 variant additionally uses archived sharp O(N log N) parity smoothing (DS Lemma14/Section3 Plancherel input) and inverse-polylog deficits only at intermediate lengths. Elementary projection norm and Dirichlet occurrence bounds are derived.
- Remaining obligation: Prove or refute the proposed uniform or scale-product conditional-decorrelation estimate, particularly at growing-N near-minimal endpoints; independent review of the conditional bootstrap and exact negative witness.
- Limitations: No all-N proof of the static premise and no unconditional new general local gap. Four numerical cases hit the iteration cap; seed agreement is not a certificate. Extension to other groups requires conditional factorization, compatible local forms and a base gap.
- Version / verdict binding: 2026-10-20 same-author conditional proofs and exact falsification, provisionally registered. Prior length-three proof and sharp smoothing are named dependencies, not new independent certification.
- Evidence: [decorrelation-bootstrap-plan](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/plan.md), [decorrelation-bootstrap-proof](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/proof.md), [decorrelation-bootstrap-check](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/check.py), [decorrelation-bootstrap-results](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/results.jsonl), [decorrelation-bootstrap-ledger](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/claim_ledger.md), [decorrelation-bootstrap-report](../../experiments/20261020-073334-bridge-decorrelation-bootstrap/report.md)
- Adjudication: None recorded for this scope.
- Logical dependencies: [HB-ADJACENT-LOCAL](RESULTS.md#hb-adjacent-local), [HB-BASE](RESULTS.md#hb-base)
- Regressions / disagreements: m0,1 singleton/empty; m2 direct; N2 singleton; feasible odd endpoints; near-minimal endpoints included in declared finite range. rho<=1/2 refuted at S5,m4. S3 correlation zero at all nonempty overlaps by exact parity uniformity. Archive M10 already supplies large-overlap correlation and recursion above smoothing scale. This record proposes its unproved balanced-overlap extension at shorter scales, not a rediscovery or unconditional completion. The o(N) overlap obstruction with N^3 tails has a different geometry.

<a id="alt-relaxed-endpoint"></a>
## ALT-RELAXED-ENDPOINT: Two-transposition endpoint relaxation: connectivity, slowdown and sampling reduction

Half-lazy single-gate refresh with endpoint defect at most two connects all exact identity words for every N and even m. Complete finite quotient checks prove full connectivity for all N at even m<=6. At m4 and N>=14 a repeated-pair cut gives gap<=5/binom(N,2) and mixing time>=floor(binom(N,2)/10). A k2 polynomial mixing theorem would imply near-uniform exact-identity sampling with O(N^4) rejection overhead; general rapid mixing remains unresolved.

- Effective status: **provisional**; source: proved exact-core connectivity, fixed-short-length full connectivity, quadratic slowdown and count/rejection reduction; empirical finite spectra; all-length rapid mixing unresolved
- Mapping depth: statement-and-verdict-traced. Required identity S3,m4 and S4,m4,m6; 62571 exact move simulations; five labeled/quotient graph agreements; nine quotient counts checked against labeled DP, up to 46854304 allowed words; 231160 count inequalities; exact cut flux at eight N through 100. Two numerical seeds with residuals, no gap lower certificate.
- Model: relaxed-endpoint; parameters: All transpositions, rightmost-first, identity center. R holds with probability 1/2, otherwise replaces a uniform gate by a uniform transposition and rejects iff defect exceeds k. N>=2, main even m>=4, k=2. Exact-core path length <=4(N+3)m^2. Identity mass >=1/[1+2C(N,3)+3C(N,4)].
- Guards: The target permits nonidentity words and is not the exact bridge law. k1 equals k0 at even lengths; k2 is unrestricted in S3/S4. Strict defect descent fails. Connectivity and a quadratic mixing lower bound do not imply rapid mixing. Increasing k does not make the gap monotone.
- Assumptions: Elementary cycle arithmetic and Cauchy--Schwarz; constructive fixed-endpoint vertex sweep reproduced from HB-NONLOCAL-LIFT; complete ordered-word relabeling quotient with support size <=m+k and exact orbit weights. The sampling consequence assumes an unproved polynomial worst-case mixing bound.
- Remaining obligation: Prove boundary-shell access and an inverse-polynomial gap at growing N,m for k2 or a separately specified logarithmic budget; independently review the proofs and finite-completeness argument.
- Limitations: Fixed-length completeness extends N only, not m. Constant-budget rejection overhead is polynomial; the crude logarithmic-budget overhead is quasipolynomial. Appending a correction does not preserve exact-word uniformity. No independent proof certification.
- Version / verdict binding: 2026-10-26 same-author proofs, exhaustive checks and two independent counting implementations; provisional integration with no mathematical acceptance upgrade.
- Evidence: [relaxed-endpoint-plan-md](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/plan.md), [relaxed-endpoint-proof-md](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/proof.md), [relaxed-endpoint-check-py](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/check.py), [relaxed-endpoint-results-jsonl](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/results.jsonl), [relaxed-endpoint-spectral-jsonl](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/spectral.jsonl), [relaxed-endpoint-quotient-py](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/quotient.py), [relaxed-endpoint-quotient-jsonl](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/quotient.jsonl), [relaxed-endpoint-audit-py](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/audit.py), [relaxed-endpoint-audit-jsonl](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/audit.jsonl), [relaxed-endpoint-claim-ledger-md](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/claim_ledger.md), [relaxed-endpoint-report-md](../../experiments/20261026-141337-relaxed-endpoint-refresh/report.md)
- Adjudication: None recorded for this scope.
- Logical dependencies: [HB-NONLOCAL-LIFT](RESULTS.md#hb-nonlocal-lift)
- Regressions / disagreements: m0,m2,N2 and odd relaxed/empty exact fibers checked. Witness ((12),(13),(24),(34)) refutes strict descent and admits defects 2,2,0. Length-eight generation stopped without a result. Uses the later constructive fixed-endpoint connectivity argument, not the historical unverified Hurwitz classification. Ordered-word symmetry quotient is distinct from the rejected unordered-support projection. No original-chain mixing result is upgraded.

Normalize complete-graph/star interchange gaps by edge count and remove constant/sign sectors for the dense endpoint estimates. This is not a bridge-chain gap. Import and parity transfer traced through dense-audit; no new source-paper audit.
- **E-VAKIL**: [Ravi Vakil, Genus 0 and 1 Hurwitz numbers: recursions, formulas, and graph-theoretic interpretations, source dated July 3, 2000](https://math.stanford.edu/~vakil/files/g01hurwitz.pdf), Section 1.2, Corollary 1.5; positive expansion in Proposition 3.2. - **E-BIT**: [T. Ben-Itzhak and M. Teicher, Graph theoretic method for determining Hurwitz equivalence in the symmetric group, arXiv:math/0110110v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0110110v1), Theorem 3.4 and Definitions 1.3, 3.1-3.3. Equal labeled support components and component weights classify identity-transposition Hurwitz orbits. Their generator is the inverse project generator; orbit equivalence is unchanged. - **E-JSTV**: [M. Jerrum, J.-B. Son, P. Tetali and E. Vigoda, Elementary bounds on Poincare and log-Sobolev constants for decomposable Markov chains](https://doi.org/10.1214/105051604000000639), Theorem 1; archived M15 application and L-0022. Stationary-flow projection and rejected-exit restriction gaps combine; half-laziness gives gap(K)>=bar_gap*min_gap/3. Reducible restrictions have zero gap; never renormalize away exits. Documentary translation from archived report/ledger; full external theorem not reread here.
- **E-ALOV-DOWNUP**: [Nima Anari, Kuikui Liu, Shayan Oveis Gharan and Cynthia Vinzant, Log-Concave Polynomials II: High-Dimensional Walks and an FPRAS for Counting Bases of a Matroid, arXiv:1811.01816v3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1811.01816v3), Definition of M_mu and Theorem 1.1 on PDF p.2; Theorem 5.2 on PDF p.23. Unit-weight graphic matroid of K_N has rank N-1. Delete a uniform tree edge and reinsert a uniform cross-component edge including the old edge; gap at least 1/(N-1), without added laziness. Used only for AUX-TREE-SLIDES. Primary theorem statements and exact kernel specialization checked on 2026-10-14; external theorem invoked, not reproved.
- **E-GJV-CYCLE**: [I. P. Goulden, D. M. Jackson and R. Vakil, Towards the geometry of double Hurwitz numbers, January 19, 2005 primary preprint](https://math.stanford.edu/~vakil/files/Djan2005.pdf), Proposition 1.1 (Hurwitz axioms); Theorem 3.1, equation (21). Set alpha=(N), beta=(1^N), r=N-1+2h. Their H=(N-1)!F_h counts all full-cycle endpoints; reverse ordered factors for the project convention. Supplies scalar fixed-cycle counts for ALT-TREE-EXTRAS and HB-CYCLE-EXCESS, not a mixing theorem. Local orbit projections on uniform L2 commute except with two neighbors. Bound the matching projection product using the full unnormalized gap, then compare actual layers. Primary hypotheses, noncommutation parameter and normalization checked by author 2026-10-15; external theorem invoked, not reproved.
- **E-CLR-PARALLEL**: [Caputo, Liggett and Richthammer, Proof of Aldous spectral gap conjecture, arXiv:0906.1238v4](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0906.1238v4), Theorem 1.1 and Section 1.2 generators.
